snippet.title: Lou's Lagoon - Kickstarter Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Traverse the vibrant Limbo Archipelago in search of your Uncle Lou, who mysteriously disappeared and left you his seaplane delivery service. Explore the islands, harvest resources, and hone your crafting skills to complete jobs and grow your business!
